subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep current main's systemd exit-78 supervised-lock policy, or adopt this PR's exit-0 authenticated probe behavior for healthy EADDRINUSE conflicts?
rationale: Both paths aim to stop restart loops, but current main deliberately uses exit 78 for systemd `Restart=always` while this PR reports success with exit 0; choosing the permanent supervisor contract is maintainer product/ops policy, not an automation-safe cleanup choice.

options.title: Rebase around exit-78 policy
options.body: Require a rebase that preserves current systemd exit-78 behavior, keeps current update-cli coverage, and adds any stricter probe only where it does not regress supervised startup semantics.

options.title: Adopt exit-0 probe semantics
options.body: Accept that a healthy EADDRINUSE conflict is reported as success, while taking ownership of the `Restart=always` ambiguity that current main removed.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: If current main's `/healthz` plus exit-78 behavior is the intended product direction, close this stale branch and request a fresh narrow issue or PR only for a proven remaining auth-aware probe gap.

recommendation.title: Rebase around exit-78 policy
recommendation.body: Require a rebase that preserves current systemd exit-78 behavior, keeps current update-cli coverage, and adds any stricter probe only where it does not regress supervised startup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current main systemd EADDRINUSE policy this PR would need to preserve or intentionally replace.
